whyTurf.label: We Love Artificial Turf
whyTurf.heading: Here Are A Few Reasons Why You'll *Love It* Too

benefits.heading: Low Maintenance Costs
benefits.body: You don't need to water, mow, or fertilize artificial turf, saving you both time & money!

benefits.heading: Safe For Children + Pets
benefits.body: Artificial turf is allergen-free, easy to clean, and comfortable to play on.

benefits.heading: Looks Perfect Year-Round
benefits.body: Regardless of the season or weather changes, artificial turf stays green all year.

benefits.heading: Fewer Outdoor Pests
benefits.body: Not only does artificial turf look great, but it also doesn't attract bugs like natural grass does.

benefits.heading: No Harmful Chemicals
benefits.body: Unlike natural grass, artificial turf doesn't require treatment with pesticides and fertilizers!

benefits.heading: Great ROI
benefits.body: Artificial turf can boost the value of your home + instantly improves curb appeal!

cards.heading: Lower Your Water Bill
cards.body: Artificial turf gives you the look of green grass without your water bill skyrocketing!

cards.heading: Built for Arizona Heat
cards.body: With stellar durability and heat tolerance, artificial turf can handle all weather conditions.

cards.heading: Drought-Proof Beauty
cards.body: Even through a severe drought, artificial turf will always look lush and beautiful!

cards.heading: Family & Pet Friendly
cards.body: Your kids and pets will love playing on artificial turf — it's super comfortable to tumble around on.

cards.heading: Minimal Maintenance
cards.body: Say goodbye to mowing, fertilizing, and pulling weeds! Artificial turf requires very minimal maintenance.

cards.heading: Smart Long-Term Investment
cards.body: Artificial grass is a smart investment that will save you a lot of money and headache in the long run!

steps.heading: Contact Us
steps.body: Over the phone or in-person. Be sure to bring measurements of the areas you want to lay turf — length and width in feet.

steps.heading: Work With Our Team
steps.body: One of our sales representatives will help you choose the right turf for your project and will be able to give you a pricing quote!

steps.heading: Purchase Your Turf
steps.body: We have both delivery and pick-up options available, so choose whatever works best for you!

cards.heading: Pavers & Hardscaping
cards.body: We are a proud dealer of top-quality concrete pavers to complete your landscape borders, patios, and driveways. We feature brands like Phoenix Paver, Ackerstone, and Belgard.

cards.heading: Natural Stone
cards.body: Elevate your pool decks and walkways with premium natural stone. Available in Travertine and Limestone, with various colors and sizes available.

cards.heading: Landscape Lighting
cards.body: Illuminate your new yard with our Lumenex lighting brand. We stock wire lighting, path lights, spotlights, and transformers.

cards.heading: Accessories
cards.body: Everything you need for a perfect installation, including Camofill, silica sand, 15-year weed fabric, seam tape, turf glue, nails, and golf cups/flags.
